fixture.label: Original synthetic arithmetic, not operational evidence or approved journal entry policy

assumptions: One oil product; measured equals sold; no inventory or quality adjustment
20 percent royalty before transport solely a supplied private-contract assumption, not statutory federal rate
Operator collects all proceeds as settlement agent; partner amounts are not operator revenue merely because cash received
Working-interest shares apply after royalty and transport in this synthetic agreement; contract determines actual allocation
Gross versus net financial-statement revenue is a separate role/control analysis, not inferred from net cash
Operator pays full approved cost invoice
Partner reimbursement clears receivable, not service revenue
Capital versus expense classification depends on cost-stage evidence and selected policy

classification_branch.assumption: Separate supplied fact: the approved joint invoice is routine maintenance of producing wells, not access to new proved reserves or acquisition/exploration. The original ownership split remains 60/40.
classification_branch.counterexample: Without invoice-stage evidence retain pending classification; the ownership percentage alone does not establish expense or capitalization.

assumptions: Two alternative estimates for same illustrative calculation, not two postings
Cost base assumed already reconciled to eligible cost center including applicable future-development and abandonment adjustments
No impairment/ceiling conclusion from this ratio; no double-counting retirement amounts
Revised reserve evidence needs effective-date and prospective accounting assessment

suspense.rule: Unresolved ownership cannot be treated as additional operator revenue; retain reconciliation and require title/contract disposition

support.assumption: Service contractor has no mineral or working interest; fee earned only under supplied service-performance facts

settlement_ledger.scope: Operator collection-agent clearing subledger only. Producer revenue/cost recognition must be posted separately from supported title/control analysis. No entry treats net cash as revenue.
settlement_ledger.open_reconciliation: Own-interest clearing is deliberately unresolved until separately approved production receivable/revenue/cost entries reconcile; this bridge is not a complete income statement.

recognition_branch.label: Separate original synthetic recognized-sale branch, not inferred from collection alone
recognition_branch.source_locator: ASU2016-08 amended606-10-55-36 through55-39A, historical amendment; current consolidated text not verified
assumptions: Supplied private division order gives mineral owner200bbl, operator480bbl and partner320bbl of the1000bbl sold. Each controls its own entitlement before purchaser delivery.
Valid enforceable customer contracts, fixed $70/bbl transaction price, completed delivery and no remaining performance obligations are supplied scenario facts, not verified real evidence.

The operator is unpaid collection agent for the other owners and principal only for its480bbl. Royalty is an ownership entitlement in this branch, not an additional operator expense. Different lease terms require a different analysis.
Transportation occurs after control transfers to the purchaser and is a separate owner cost, $1200operator/$800partner. No bundled shipping promise or variable price deductions.
This branch reclassifies the completed clearing example; it does not add another receipt. Production costs/depletion remain separate from this sales bridge.
recognition_branch.counterexample: If title, control transfer or performance completion is missing, leave the collection-only clearing balance unresolved; collected cash and division arithmetic alone do not prove revenue. No operator revenue for partner/mineral-owner proceeds.

retirement.label: Original synthetic annual rollforward, separate from April sales totals
assumptions: A normal-use legal well-retirement obligation is incurred at the start of the annual interval; reasonable fair value is supplied as $100,000, not derived from an engineering estimate here.
Five-percent original credit-adjusted risk-free rate, full year elapsed, no settlements or new obligations before year-end revision.
A separately supplied upward-revision present value of $20,000 is measured at the current rate after accretion. This is not $20,000 of undiscounted cash flows.

The retirement asset component uses a separately supplied ten-year straight-line useful life for this illustration. It is excluded from the other depletion-sensitivity cost base so the same retirement cost is not allocated twice.
counterexamples: A disposal plan alone or improper-operation remediation does not establish this historical retirement model.
A surety bond is not settlement of the retirement liability; keep funding and obligation records separate.
Downward revisions do not automatically use the new upward-revision discount rate; preserve historical layers.
Missing reasonable measurement is a disclosed evidence gap, not an assumed zero liability.
source_locators: FAS143 paragraphs2-3,11,13-16,22; PDF pages7,9-12 one-based; historical source, not current ASC410 verification

royalty_reporting.scope: Separate original synthetic handbook-field illustration; no actual federal rate or allowance eligibility established
royalty_reporting.counterexample: Using the division-order percentage produces375000 before allowances, not625000; deducting the entire transport invoice incorrectly produces425000. Verify actual lease, relief and allowable royalty-share inputs before filing.

cost_stage.scope: Separate synthetic full-cost entity, one US country cost center; dated April 2025 SEC rule. These invoices are not additional amounts in the production settlement or depletion sensitivity.
counterexamples: Do not place another country in this cost center.
An exploration dry hole does not remain indefinitely outside the amortization pool.
This selected full-cost branch does not determine successful-efforts or hard-rock treatment.
